safe_sentence: Capital is visibly moving through distinct wrappers into real-economy assets, projects, borrowers, collateral pools, and operating platforms, but the current evidence proves the full cash-return chain only in pieces.
evidence_basis: 16-case CFNSAQ execution synthesis; five executed next-source acquisition packages; evidence ledger controls
what_this_answers: Answers the broad who-invests-where and how-money-moves question at current proof level.
required_boundary: Every sentence must say that full asset-level cash-return proof remains unproven.
do_not_say: Do not say the thesis is fully proven or that any case has full source-use-cash-payback-return proof.
next_decisive_source: Named receipts, lender waterfalls, legal-entity schedules, collateral certificates, and return models

safe_sentence: Wheaton Antamina is the strongest named asset partial: a 4.300B USD PMPA cash use is visible, bank-debt financing context is visible, and H1 2026 Antamina stream revenue and cash-cost evidence are visible.
evidence_basis: Wheaton Antamina proof stack, net cash return pass, CFNSAQ-003, CFNSAQ-005
what_this_answers: Identifies the best case where money can be followed into a named asset and observed returning as stream economics.
required_boundary: The missing layer is delivered-ounce cash receipt detail, tax and interest allocation, lender waterfall, reserve-life support, and PMPA IRR/NPV.
do_not_say: Do not call Antamina a full financed cash-return proof case.
next_decisive_source: Delivery/cash receipt schedule plus PMPA lender waterfall and reserve/mine-plan support

safe_sentence: FPL Distribution Inspection is the strongest regulated recovery bridge: category output, cost, recovery, component attribution, aggregate SPPCRC revenue, and true-up collection/refund mechanics are visible.
evidence_basis: FPL source test, working-capital collection pass, return-model pass, CFNSAQ synthesis
what_this_answers: Shows how utility capital can move into a regulated activity and become authorized recovery and aggregate collection evidence.
required_boundary: Distribution Inspection-specific customer receipts, billing determinants, rate-class allocation, funding-source allocation, and actual earned return remain missing.
do_not_say: Do not say customers paid cash specifically for Distribution Inspection or that shareholder return is realized.
next_decisive_source: 2027 SPPCRC actual/estimated filing and billing determinant/category collection support

safe_sentence: United Rentals, Sterling, and MasTec show the operating conversion pattern: fleet productivity, backlog burn, revenue, operating cash flow, and working-capital timing can make capital movement visible before asset-level returns are proven.
evidence_basis: URI fleet rows, Sterling backlog rows, MasTec backlog rows, CFNSAQ-001, CFNSAQ-002, CFNSAQ-004, CFNSAQ-005
what_this_answers: Explains where money appears to move into operating systems and come back as company-level cash or cash proxy.
required_boundary: Fleet-class ROIC, named owner collections, receivable aging, retainage collection, project margin, legal availability, and source-to-project allocation remain missing.
do_not_say: Do not treat backlog, OCF, DSO, or OEC productivity as full project or asset cash-return proof.
next_decisive_source: Fleet-class ROIC support; receivable/retainage collection schedules; ABL/AR borrowing-base certificates

safe_sentence: Cheniere and Energy Transfer have strong company cash, output, contract, debt, and capex evidence, but both still fail at named train or named project cash contribution and debt-service waterfall proof.
evidence_basis: Cheniere train cash waterfall source test, Energy Transfer named-project cash source test, CFNSAQ-002, CFNSAQ-003, CFNSAQ-005
what_this_answers: Separates high-quality energy infrastructure proxies from project-level cash-return proof.
required_boundary: Train/entity EBITDA, restricted-account waterfall, SPA cash attribution, project revenue, project EBITDA/DCF, shipper billing, and debt-service allocation remain missing.
do_not_say: Do not say named LNG trains or ET projects have proven project cash returns.
next_decisive_source: Terminal/train cash waterfalls, SPA revenue attribution, shipper billing, and project EBITDA bridges

safe_sentence: PBF, Matador, Liberty Broadband, and Devon improve the money-route answer because refinancing, borrowing-base, holdco collateral, and treasury source/use mechanics are visible.
evidence_basis: CFNSAQ-003; CFNSAQ-004; PBF, Matador, Liberty, Devon bridge rows
what_this_answers: Shows where proceeds, repayments, borrowings, collateral, and aggregate source/use can be traced better than in pure operating cases.
required_boundary: Settlement statements, borrowing notices, lender schedules, LTV certificates, borrowing-base certificates, source-priority ledgers, and asset cash contribution remain missing.
do_not_say: Do not say these rows prove full lender payback or asset-level return.
next_decisive_source: Redemption settlements, borrowing notices, lender allocation schedules, LTV certificates, borrowing-base certificates, and treasury ledgers

safe_sentence: Apollo/Athene, KKR/Global Atlantic, Blackstone, and Ares show large capital channels and selected borrower/facility markers, but legal-entity and borrower-level proof remain the bottleneck.
evidence_basis: CFNSAQ-004; statutory asset-income route; borrower facility route; Blackstone, KKR/Global Atlantic, Apollo/Athene, Ares rows
what_this_answers: Explains why platform AUM, inflows, policy liabilities, and borrower markers are useful but not enough.
required_boundary: Statutory Schedule D/BA, legal-entity investment income, NAIC designations, FHLB collateral files, vehicle-to-borrower allocation, funded tranche share, and borrower use-of-proceeds remain missing.
do_not_say: Do not allocate platform AUM or insurance investments to named borrowers without a bridge.
next_decisive_source: Statutory filings, Schedule D/BA, FHLB collateral files, N-PORT/SMA holdings, borrower credit agreements, lender schedules

safe_sentence: The conclusion changes only when a row joins same-period source, use, output, customer cash, debt-service or payback, and return evidence at the named asset/project/borrower/facility level.
evidence_basis: CFNSAQ pass tests and synthesis safe claims
what_this_answers: Defines the upgrade rule for every future source acquisition pass.
required_boundary: Proxy evidence remains below full proof unless the row-level chain is joined.
do_not_say: Do not upgrade from AUM, backlog, capex, route rate, cargo count, aggregate revenue, or company OCF alone.
next_decisive_source: Named customer receipts, project cash contribution schedules, lender waterfalls, statutory/legal-entity schedules, collateral certificates, and full return models
